_comment: MDFC: A BOUNCED BACK-FACE LAND RETURNS AS ITS FRONT (CR 712.8a; Morph INT-4, sweep g10 seed 50010 T2).
Turn 3: a face-up Den Protector (2/1, not sick), Legion Stronghold (Legion Leadership's land back face) as
our only land, Gruul Turf in hand, the opponent at 6. Play Gruul Turf: its ETB must return a land, and
Stronghold is the only one, so it goes back to hand -- as Legion Leadership. Attack for 2 (4 left). Turn 4:
Turf + the drawn Forest pay {1}{R/W} for Legion Leadership on Den Protector (double its power: 4) -> lethal.
DISCRIMINATING: before the fix the spell//land back-face synthesis dropped mdfc_front_name, so the bounce
returned a land-only 'Legion Stronghold' and no pump exists on turn 4 (2 + 2 = 4 < 6: no win by turn 4).
Every battlefield -> zone push now maps a back face to its front through RevealedCard (SpellEffects.h).
